page_title: RBL 0-0 MAI | RB Leipzig v Mainz 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+5' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 10:1.
90+2' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for RB Leipzig! Play can continue.

90+2' There's a break in play and referee Frank Willenborg must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by RB Leipzig using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+1' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Golden opportunity! Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
87' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Yussuf Poulsen and he is replaced by Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig).
86' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
85' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Benjamin Henrichs walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) will replace Kevin Kampl.
81' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) replaces Andreas Hanche-Olsen.
79' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Frank Willenborg had an easy-decision to make.
77' The attendance is 44813.
76' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar.
75' The referee blows his whistle as Brajan Gruda (Mainz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
70' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Frank Willenborg and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Peter Gulacsi, who smothers the ball.
68' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Lois Openda will be replaced by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) comes onto the pitch for Christoph Baumgartner.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Frank Willenborg didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
66' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
64' The ball is cleared after Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
62' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
61' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
58' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' The referee signals a substitution. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Anthony Caci.
56' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Ludovic Ajorque is replaced by Brajan Gruda (Mainz).
56' Karim Onisiwo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz).
56' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
55' A cross from a corner kick by RB Leipzig is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
55' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' The resulting set piece from RB Leipzig is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
52' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Robin Zentner stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
48' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
46' Referee Frank Willenborg blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' The shots on goal statistics – 6:0.
45+4' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+1' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' David Raum (RB Leipzig) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
42' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
39' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
37' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Zentner comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
33' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
33' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) commits a rough foul. Frank Willenborg stops the game and makes a call.
32' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
29' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
27' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Frank Willenborg had an easy-decision to make.
25' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
21' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Anthony Caci (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
19' David Raum (RB Leipzig) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

17' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
16' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
14' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
14' A cross into the box from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is cleared.
13' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
12' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
11' The RB Leipzig players can’t believe it after referee Frank Willenborg signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

9' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for RB Leipzig.
8' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
6' David Raum (RB Leipzig) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
4' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Mainz will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Frank Willenborg.
